data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open the booking form, type origin and destination and pick the suggestion, choose dates, click Find flights) with the right parameters, but it adds roundtrip/one-way and traveler/cabin steps that the observed actions don't show, and it omits the "Book with miles" toggle and the fare selection.
